title: Which bassists had the biggest sound
summary: Walter Page had an immense sound; others named are Hinton, Blanton, Pettiford and Braud.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Who of the guys you knew, who had the biggest sound that you were -- or who were some of the ones that had the biggest sound?
Well, Walter Page was one. He had immense sound.
Heavy, real heavy, and that's what a bass -- a bass needs, you know, is that sound, depth.
So you said Walter Page was one.
What about Wellman Braud, did he?
Blanton's sound was big and Pettiford.
Pettiford, yes. Most of the bass players had big, big sounds.
